# Agentic Orchestration Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that orchestration requirements describe a stateful, non-linear, governed engine rather than linear agent chaining.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is an explicit dependency graph required in which every stage declares inputs, outputs, entry and exit criteria, owner and failure behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-005; CON II] [D03] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Do the requirements mandate at least one parallel fork and a synchronization point, so that a purely sequential chain fails them? [Coverage, Spec §FR-ORC-006, §FR-ORC-037, §FR-ORC-038] [D01] [D04] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is persistence of workflow state, stage outputs, cross-stage context and artifact versions required to survive process interruption? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-011; ADR-015] [D02] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are run, node and gate state machines specified with both allowed and prohibited transitions? [Completeness, data-model.md §2; CON II] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is decision lineage required, linking each decision to its rationale and the artifact versions it affects? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-013] [D05] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is dynamic replanning specified with trigger, scope rule (affected subgraph only), approval revocation and audit events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-020, §FR-ORC-021; ADR-017] [D21] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Are all three scenarios required to execute through the engine, with no scenario capability delivered outside a workflow run? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-031, §CST-007] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is each conditional branch listed with its condition and a recorded skip reason (G-CLARIFY, ST-05, G-SECURITY, REL-02/G-CORRECTIVE)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-007; Plan §3.2; workflow-graph.v2.yaml] [D01] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Are sync-point release conditions specified for suspended, failed and blocked branches? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-ORC-039] [D04] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the Glossary definition of "dependent path" (all nodes reachable downstream from the affected node in the run's graph instance, up to and including the next synchronization point) let every node be classified unambiguously as dependent or independent? [Clarity, Spec §Glossary (CR-003), §FR-ORC-022; ADR-017] [D21] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is a scheduler-stall condition defined, with safe-stop as its outcome? [Edge Case, Plan §6.1 (CR-002); ADR-013] [D19] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it specified that deterministic late-ambiguity demonstrations use labeled finding injection, so they are not presented as organic detection? [Clarity, ADR-017; CON X] [D23] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Is the exactly-one-terminal-outcome rule specified for every graph path, including ABORTED, release `not_ready` and compensated paths? [Coverage, Spec §FR-ORC-023; workflow-graph.v2.yaml terminal_rules] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the determinism requirement reconciled with real parallel execution through a stated commit-order rule? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-DET-001; ADR-003] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Is AI-backed mode required to pass through identical gates, policy checks, permission checks and audit as deterministic mode? [Consistency, Spec §FR-ORC-030] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Is at-most-once application of duplicate stage-completion and decision events specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-ORC-028] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Are interruption and resumption requirements specified per stage boundary, with the expected terminal outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-ORC-019, §NFR-RCV-001; PVT-006] [D20] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
